C_commodore_ella_venn.name: Commodore Ella Venn
C_commodore_ella_venn.visual: Late-middle-aged woman with an angular, composed face and dark hair strongly streaked with silver, secured in a low command bun.

C_admiral_cael_dominion.name: Admiral Cael Dominion
C_admiral_cael_dominion.visual: Older Fleet admiral with close-cut silver hair, a long severe face, and immaculate formal bearing.

C_abby_saville.name: Abby Saville
C_abby_saville.role: Shards — Warlord of the Scythe of Saville
C_abby_saville.visual: Tall, athletic Black woman with dark brown skin, long tight braids pulled back cleanly, and a focused, watchful face.

C_tessa_banks.name: Tessa Banks
C_tessa_banks.visual: Compact adult white woman with short-to-medium silver-gray curls and an alert, intelligent face.

C_billie_rusk.name: Billie Rusk
C_billie_rusk.visual: Lean adult white woman with vivid red hair worn loose and rough, a sharp expressive face, and restless physical energy.

C_governor_halev.name: Governor Chris Halev
C_governor_halev.role: Verge — Civil leader of Auric Bazaar
C_governor_halev.visual: Middle-aged man with short dark hair, a lean tired face, and work-worn hands.

C_captain_naomi_sol.name: Captain Naomi Sol
C_captain_naomi_sol.visual: Lean woman with dark hair pulled into a functional braid, a visible brow scar, and an intent, weathered face.

C_jex_marrin.name: Jex Marrin
C_jex_marrin.visual: Older white-haired Verge broker with a short rough beard, a creased face, and the relaxed stance of someone always pricing the room.

C_elder_wallace.name: Brent Wallace
C_elder_wallace.visual: Older Verge trader with a broad weathered face, thinning gray hair, and the practical bulk of someone who has spent decades around freight and docks.

C_oren_pike.name: Oren Pike
C_oren_pike.visual: Adult Shard captain with a lean angular face, cropped dark hair, and a charismatic showman’s posture that reads as deliberate rather than manic.

C_silent_triarch.name: The Silent Triarch
C_silent_triarch.visual: Three masked Shard rulers presented as a coordinated council presence; pale industrial ceremonial layers, bright red control markings, and distinct expressionless masks rather than interchangeable hooded figures.

C_luminara_mother.name: Luminara Mother
C_luminara_mother.visual: Tired adult Verge mother in worn tan-and-muted-green civilian layers, practical hair tied back, protective posture centered on her child.

C_luminara_boy.name: Luminara Boy
C_luminara_boy.visual: Young Verge boy in patched civilian work-clothes, alert eyes, and a small practical satchel; visibly a child, never miniaturized adult military styling.

C_archivist_selene_stormwell.name: Archivist Selene Stormwell
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.role: Fleet — historical analyst, Stormwell research office
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.visual: Older Fleet historical analyst with silver hair in a disciplined braid, a calm lined face, and practical research-duty clothing built for consoles, interviews, and field records rather than ceremonial display.

C_liora_virelia.name: Liora Virelia
C_liora_virelia.visual: Adult High Era physicist in clean practical engineering and research clothing, shown around corridor models, transit telemetry, and working technical systems rather than archival ceremony.

C_lieutenant_deka.name: Lieutenant Erin Deka
C_lieutenant_deka.visual: Adult Fleet lieutenant with close-kept hair, alert practical expression, and standard deep-navy duty uniform with restrained gold insignia.

C_jia_morgan.name: Jia Morgan
C_jia_morgan.visual: Adult technical analyst with short dark hair, an observant focused face, and compact Fleet technical-duty layers suited to consoles and field instruments.

C_soren_kerr.name: Admiral Soren Kerr
C_soren_kerr.visual: Older Fleet admiral with cropped gray hair, a composed weathered face, and understated deep-navy Cerulean command dress emphasizing restraint rather than ornament.

C_tom_barrett.name: Tom Barrett
C_tom_barrett.visual: Adult Shard captain in pale-gray industrial command layers with narrow bright-red faction markings and a work-worn shipboard silhouette.

C_second.name: Second
C_second.visual: Adult Verge escort second officer in patched tan-and-muted-green flight gear, visibly crew rather than Fleet command.

C_officer.name: Officer
C_officer.visual: Fleet duty officer in established deep-navy uniform with restrained gold piping; use as a supporting crew figure, not a new hero design.

C_raider.name: Raider
C_raider.visual: Shard raider in established pale-gray industrial armor with bright-red markings and visibly repaired working gear.

C_fleet_sergeant.name: Fleet Sergeant
C_fleet_sergeant.visual: Fleet sergeant in established deep-navy duty uniform with practical security gear and clear enlisted rather than command styling.

C_tactical.name: Tactical
C_tactical.visual: Fleet tactical officer in established deep-navy duty uniform at an active command console; supporting crew identity, not a distinct command costume.

C_medic.name: Medic
C_medic.visual: Fleet medic in established deep-navy duty layers adapted for medical work, carrying compact diagnostic and treatment equipment.

C_crew_various.name: Crew (various)
C_crew_various.visual: Fleet crew ensemble using the established deep-navy duty-uniform language with role-specific practical variation and no duplicate hero faces.

C_rival_captain.name: Rival Captain
C_rival_captain.visual: Shard rival captain in established pale-gray industrial command wear with bright-red faction markings, distinct from named principal captains.

C_scribe.name: Scribe
C_scribe.visual: Civilian or court scribe in restrained local work layers carrying a slate or record tool; visually subordinate to the principal speakers.

C_emissary.name: Emissary
C_emissary.visual: Triarch emissary in pale industrial Shard ceremonial layers with narrow bright-red markings, distinct from the masked ruling council.

C_silent_triarch_raid.name: Silent Triarch — Raid
C_silent_triarch_raid.visual: One distinct masked Triarch aspect in pale industrial ceremonial layers with bright-red markings; the Raid mask reads forceful through geometry and stance without exposing a face.

C_silent_triarch_fear.name: Silent Triarch — Fear
C_silent_triarch_fear.visual: One distinct masked Triarch aspect in pale industrial ceremonial layers with bright-red markings; the Fear mask reads controlled and clinical rather than monstrous.

C_child.name: Child
C_child.visual: Civilian child in setting-appropriate worn practical clothing; child proportions and behavior, no military styling unless explicitly scripted.

C_admiral_colin_rhyne.name: Admiral Colin Rhyne
C_admiral_colin_rhyne.visual: Older Fleet admiral in established deep-navy Aegis command dress, with a practical defensive bearing and restrained senior-officer presentation.

C_admiral_janet_keating.name: Admiral Janet Keating
C_admiral_janet_keating.visual: Middle-aged Fleet admiral with short dark hair touched with gray, a firm square face, and immaculate deep-navy command dress worn with hard-line military precision.

C_silent_triarch_trade.name: Silent Triarch — Trade
C_silent_triarch_trade.visual: One distinct masked Triarch aspect in pale industrial ceremonial layers with bright-red markings; the Trade mask reads measured and transactional through clean formal geometry.

C_richard_secundo.name: Dr. Richard Secundo
C_richard_secundo.role: Shard civilian — Tal Corvus physician and refugee witness
C_richard_secundo.visual: Adult man from Tal Corvus with the composed, attentive presence of an experienced civilian physician.

C_paul_secundo.name: Paul Secundo
C_paul_secundo.role: Shard civilian — 19-year-old engineering apprentice and refugee
C_paul_secundo.visual: 19-year-old adult man and refugee, with an observant, weathered young face and a healing injury supported by a practical brace.

C_sera_dain.name: Councilor Sera Dain
C_sera_dain.role: Verge — elected representative of Auric's overcrowded working districts
C_sera_dain.visual: Adult Auric councilor with a practical expressive face, dark hair kept simply for work, durable tan-and-green district clothing, and a scuffed council folio.

C_tali_marrin.name: Tali Marrin
C_tali_marrin.role: Independent refuge keeper — Jex Marrin's younger sister
C_tali_marrin.visual: Middle-aged Verge refuge keeper with weathered features, dark hair threaded with gray, layered workwear, and subtle anomaly-glass details echoing Jex’s route culture without copying his silhouette.

C_resident_mother.name: Auric Resident Mother
C_resident_mother.visual: Adult Auric mother in worn civilian Verge clothing, protective posture centered on her child and visually separate from officials or uniformed crews.

C_resident_child.name: Auric Resident Child
C_resident_child.role: Verge civilian — child with a respiratory illness
C_resident_child.visual: Young Auric child in practical civilian clothing, visibly ill or vulnerable only when the page requires it, with child proportions and no faction uniform.

C_resident.name: Auric Resident
C_resident.visual: Auric civilian resident in worn but once-prosperous Verge clothing, visually distinct from uniformed officials and refugees.

C_refugee.name: Refugee
C_refugee.visual: Displaced civilian in layered salvaged clothing carrying only practical personal effects; avoid faction-uniform shorthand unless the page specifies it.

C_listener.name: Civilian Listener
C_listener.role: Shard civilian receiving Richard Secundo's testimony
C_listener.visual: Shard civilian listener in worn Tal Corvus work layers, individualized as an ordinary person rather than a crowd archetype.

C_guard.name: Shelter Guard
C_guard.visual: Auric civilian shelter guard in practical tan-and-green local protective gear, visibly civic rather than military.

C_civilian_pilot.name: Civilian Pilot
C_civilian_pilot.visual: Civilian evacuation pilot in practical patched flight layers with non-military Verge markings and working safety gear.

C_shard_caregiver.name: Shard Caregiver
C_shard_caregiver.role: Shard civilian caregiver — Mercy of Dawn survivor
C_shard_caregiver.visual: Adult Tal Corvus civilian in worn practical refugee layers, injured during the Mercy of Dawn evacuation but still actively protecting younger evacuees.

C_junior_rescuer.name: Junior Rescuer
C_junior_rescuer.visual: Young adult Fleet rescue crew member in practical deep-navy medical/rescue layers, clearly junior to command staff and equipped for evacuation work.

C_verge_shipboard_guard.name: Verge Shipboard Guard
C_verge_shipboard_guard.visual: Adult Verge shipboard guard in tan-and-muted-green practical security clothing with local route/service patches and functional equipment; not Fleet navy and not Shard gray-white armor.

RF_Thunderbreak_Command.name: Thunderbreak command
RF_Thunderbreak_Command.text: Thunderbreak command — a broad, disciplined heavy-cruiser bridge organized around a central command position, active tactical and navigation stations, large shared operational displays, and visible evidence of an older ship repeatedly repaired rather than cosmetically renewed. Crew movement should preserve clear station geography across returns.

RF_Admiralty_Tribunal.name: Fleet Admiralty tribunal
RF_Admiralty_Tribunal.text: Fleet Admiralty tribunal — formal Core hearing space built to make hierarchy legible: elevated circular authority positions, a lower testimony floor, controlled evidence displays, restrained stone-metal geometry, and very little visual clutter. Evidence that disrupts institutional neatness should remain physically visible once introduced.

RF_Relic_Court.name: Relic Court
RF_Relic_Court.text: Relic Court — monumental Core political chamber with bright stone, restrained banners, long sightlines, a central working table for documents and live operational feeds, and enough open floor that who joins or refuses the table is visually meaningful.

RF_Auric_Civic_Core.name: Auric civic and operations complex
RF_Auric_Civic_Core.text: Auric civic and operations complex — practical Verge government space embedded in a working freeport: scuffed tables, cargo and ration boards, public-facing displays, doors opening toward active docks, and officials working close to clerks, residents and freight rather than behind ceremonial barriers.

RF_Auric_Luxury_Ring.name: Auric luxury ring / Crown Ring
RF_Auric_Luxury_Ring.text: Auric luxury ring / Crown Ring — formerly expensive residential concourse converted into unstable public shelter: chandeliers and high-end finishes coexist with bedding, heaters, ration lines, temporary partitions and a large cracked observation window under continuous structural watch.

RF_Veil_Market.name: Veil Market
RF_Veil_Market.text: Veil Market — dense lived-in trade network of stalls, broker rooms, back passages and route boards with practical worklight, handwritten or chalk navigation information, layered signage and enough physical wear that commerce, refuge and rumor visibly share the same infrastructure.

RF_Gravefire_Interior.name: Gravefire interior
RF_Gravefire_Interior.text: Gravefire interior — compact Shard working ship maintained through visible repair rather than ceremony: tight stations, patched pale industrial surfaces, narrow bright-red faction markings, restrained lighting, and a cockpit/bridge geography that favors practical sightlines over spectacle.

RF_Arena_Vault.name: Shardfall Arena Vault
RF_Arena_Vault.text: Shardfall Arena Vault — vast circular Shard political chamber of pale industrial structure, bright-red control markings and dark forge-adjacent depth. Empty tiers and tactical displays should make absence of public support as visible as a crowd would be; the three Triarch masks occupy distinct, repeatable positions.

RF_Tal_Corvus_Warrens.name: Tal Corvus warrens
RF_Tal_Corvus_Warrens.text: Tal Corvus warrens — dense inhabited industrial passages carved through damp, worn infrastructure: narrow routes, practical heat and supply hardware, improvised chalk guidance, layered family habitation and recurring seams where anomaly seep can become visible without turning the space mystical.

RF_Shatterforge.name: Shatterforge
RF_Shatterforge.text: Shatterforge — enormous inhabited forge complex where ember furnaces, vent trunks, exposed bridges, blade-production halls and family quarters occupy the same vertical industrial system. Safety hardware and service vents must retain readable geography because later damage depends on where they connect.

RF_Auric_Gate.name: Auric Gate
RF_Auric_Gate.text: Auric Gate — large reciprocal-field transit installation of ember-orange pylons, stability rims, shared timing boards and civilian approach lanes. Preserve the relationship between pylons, central crossing lane, traffic-control positions and shield approaches so battle and later Accord operations read as the same place.

RF_Luminara_Fields_Dock.name: Luminara Fields agricultural freight dock
RF_Luminara_Fields_Dock.text: Luminara Fields agricultural freight dock — a bright productive Verge port embedded in cultivated land, with practical loading cranes, fabric shade, food sacks, long tan-and-muted-green farm freighters, families and workers sharing the same civic-industrial space.

RF_Kaldr_Rift.name: Kaldr Rift
RF_Kaldr_Rift.text: Kaldr Rift — a hazardous convoy passage through dense asteroid fragments, broken industrial structures and old hull wreckage. Navigation depends on physical spacing, sightlines and maneuvering through debris; never render it as a magical tunnel or portal.

RF_Verge_Escort_Cockpit.name: Verge escort cockpit
RF_Verge_Escort_Cockpit.text: Verge escort cockpit — cramped, worn and practical, with physical controls, patched tan-and-muted-green surfaces, broad forward visibility and just enough instrumentation to fly working routes. It should feel maintained and heavily used rather than primitive or dirty.

RF_Luminara_Freighter_Hold.name: Luminara farm-freighter cargo hold
RF_Luminara_Freighter_Hold.text: Luminara farm-freighter cargo hold — tall working freight volume built around strapped agricultural crates, utility rails, emergency helmets and pressure doors. Civilian passengers share the same functional space with cargo, making hull breaches and boarding actions immediately human-scale.

RF_Thunderbreak_Memorial_Deck.name: Thunderbreak memorial deck
RF_Thunderbreak_Memorial_Deck.text: Thunderbreak memorial deck — bright disciplined Fleet remembrance hall with a circular gathering floor, restrained blue-and-gold insignia, engraved casualty walls and a central geometric memorial. Treat it as service infrastructure for remembering losses, not a shrine or mystical sanctuary.

RF_Auric_Bazaar.name: Auric Bazaar
RF_Auric_Bazaar.text: Auric Bazaar — a dense but capable Verge freeport market and dock ring where cargo, food, route trade, civic relief and ordinary family life overlap. Use tan-and-muted-green working infrastructure, fabric shade, freight hardware and practical night or daylight illumination without portraying the Verge as backward.

RF_Black_Drift_Repair_Yard.name: Black Drift Shard repair yard
RF_Black_Drift_Repair_Yard.text: Black Drift Shard repair yard — inhabited asteroid-industrial dock where damaged Shard ships are maintained by large working crews using visible welding, salvaged components, pressure hardware and communal labor. Pale industrial layers and bright-red markings coexist with meals, families and lived-in repair culture.

RF_Black_Drift_Hangar.name: Black Drift hangar floor
RF_Black_Drift_Hangar.text: Black Drift hangar floor — bright functional Shard work bay around compact craft, cargo nets, parts benches and active repair stations. White/pale-gray industrial surfaces, dark underlayers and strong red markings make faction identity clear without pirate-barbarian styling.

RF_Shard_Command_Room.name: Shard command room
RF_Shard_Command_Room.text: Shard command room — practical pale industrial planning space centered on a physical terrain/route table, repair hardware and crew standing close to the work. Bright-red faction markings remain restrained; tactical planning should read as operational engineering rather than magical projection.

RF_Triarch_Chamber.name: Silent Triarch chamber
RF_Triarch_Chamber.text: Silent Triarch chamber — dark Shard political command room with three fixed authority positions for three distinct masks, practical route and status displays, pale industrial ceremonial layers and bright-red control markings. The Triarch are institutional rulers, never supernatural figures.

RF_Core_Admiralty_Chamber.name: Core Admiralty chamber
RF_Core_Admiralty_Chamber.text: Core Admiralty chamber — luminous formal Fleet decision space with white stone-metal geometry, deep-navy banners, elevated authority positions, a circular floor route display and a large shared corridor map. Institutional hierarchy is visibly spacious and orderly; green lanes appear only as measured navigation geometry.

RF_Shard_Assembly_Orbit.name: Shard assembly orbit
RF_Shard_Assembly_Orbit.text: Shard assembly orbit — dark inhabited industrial stronghold surrounded by numerous working Shard vessels and a foreground observation platform. Mobilization is communicated through ships lighting ordinary engines and taking formation, not ritual energy or supernatural effects.

F_Fleet.name: Fleet / Reach and Resolve
F_Fleet.text: Core-aligned military and relief fleet operating heavy cruisers, escorts, survey support, rescue missions, and corridor protection across a civilization still being reconnected after the Shattering.

F_Verge.name: The Verge
F_Verge.text: Frontier trade worlds, farms, freeports, escorts, and civilian governments whose institutions evolved under long periods of unreliable or absent interstellar connection.

F_Shards.name: The Shards / Confederacy
F_Shards.text: Shard settlements, salvagers, raiders, captains, engineers, civilians, and survival blocs formed in wreckage zones and scarcity after the Shattering.

F_Trade.name: Independent Trade / Veil Market
F_Trade.text: Brokers, smugglers, merchants, route specialists, and information traders operating between formal factions.

F_Lattice.name: Lattice Research / Corridor Exploration
F_Lattice.text: Physicists, survey crews, pilots, and anomaly observers studying reciprocal-field transit, damaged corridor geometry, timing irregularities, and post-Shattering phenomena.

Core.name: The Core
Core.text: Bright, ordered civic, Admiralty, Fleet Academy, shipyard, research, and command environments with polished stone, etched metal, disciplined infrastructure, and mature transit instrumentation.
Core.tone: Institutional confidence under growing political and scientific strain.

Verge.name: The Verge
Verge.text: Frontier docks, markets, farms, freeports, patched textiles, working ships, crowded civilian infrastructure, local route boards, and repair yards.
Verge.tone: Lived-in pragmatism, scarcity, trade pressure, and stubborn independence.

Shards.name: The Shards
Shards.text: Salvage cities, scarred decks, warrens, debris corridors, repair docks, improvised engineering, patched armor, and settlements built inside the physical wreckage of lost connection.
Shards.tone: Hard survival, factional rivalry, anger, and emerging solidarity.

Lattice.name: The Lattice
Lattice.text: Reciprocal-field corridors, echo space, survey stations, anchor infrastructure, and regions where geometry, timing, and reference frames become unreliable.
Lattice.tone: Scientific awe mixed with physically objective but incompletely explained risk.

Corridors.name: Inter-faction Corridors
Corridors.text: Reciprocal-field lanes, rifts, gates, convoy routes, anchor points, shear windows, orbit, docking approaches, and transit space connecting Core, Verge, Shards, and Lattice.
Corridors.tone: Movement under threat; protection, piracy, difficult navigation, and fragile cooperation.

lighting.fleetCeremonial: Bright ordered Fleet light with readable faces, etched metal, polished working surfaces, and restrained institutional formality.
lighting.vergeLivedIn: Practical dock and market illumination: worklights, daylight, storefront spill, maintenance lamps, worn textiles, and clear human-scale detail.
lighting.shardIndustrial: Bright industrial worklights, forge glow, scarred metal reflections, and controlled ember accents without obscuring faces.
lighting.latticeAnomaly: Clean readable exposure around impossible geometry, luminous nodes, mirrored or refracted structures, and restrained anomaly glow.
lighting.combatReadable: High-clarity cinematic combat lighting; motion remains readable and hull/material detail survives explosions and plasma effects.

keeper.name: Jex Marrin — Acting and Pose Study
